facts.text: Mr Percival has his fish. You've got your bread. Eat up, then watch the sand dunes.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Tom's lines on Wikiquote are about the radio telling you what you need and about sticking together.
facts.fix: The radio will tell you you need this or that and a thousand other things.

vibe.verdict: A lovely beach kiosk on the right coast with the right names, but the food is generic Aussie shack and the best moments are missing.
missing: Three orphaned pelican chicks raised by hand (Mr Proud, Mr Ponder and Mr Percival)
Tom's big fish from the river mouth carried to Fingerbone Bill's camp
The village raising money for boarding school
Mr Percival coming back after being released
ideas: Swap 'Fried whitebait with lemon' for 'Three pelican fish buckets' (one each for Proud, Ponder and Percival).
Swap 'Shack lemon myrtle billy tea' note for 'Fingerbone Bill's brew'.
Rename 'Hideaway Tom's crisp fish and chips' to 'River mouth fish and chips' after the big catch.
Add 'Storm Boy' as a named kids' drink.
